modern: Modern interiors use clean lines, neutral colors, simple furniture and minimal decoration.
scandinavian: Scandinavian interiors focus on light colors, natural wood, cozy textures and functional furniture.
bohemian: Bohemian interiors include colorful textiles, indoor plants, handcrafted decor and layered patterns.
industrial: Industrial interiors use exposed brick, concrete, metal, black accents and open spaces.
minimalist: Minimalism focuses on keeping only essential furniture with lots of open space.
lighting: Good lighting combines ambient, task and accent lighting to create balance.
living room: A living room should have a clear focal point, comfortable seating and layered lighting.
bedroom: Bedrooms should have calming colors, soft lighting and minimal clutter.
kitchen: A kitchen should follow the work triangle between the sink, stove and refrigerator.
color: Neutral colors make spaces appear larger while darker colors create depth and coziness.
